title: Add 5 premium ultra-realistic electrician looping GIFs and integrate across Hero/Services/Trust sections with reduced-motion fallbacks

requirements.summary: Add a new premium ultra-realistic looping hero GIF asset for the Home page.
acceptanceCriteria: A new generated GIF exists under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified visual characteristics.
The animation loops seamlessly (no visible jump cut).
The asset contains no embedded text or logos.

file_operations.description: Add the generated premium hero looping GIF asset (ultra-realistic electrician working inside a modern electrical distribution board; seamless loop; no text/logo).

requirements.summary: Update the Home Hero background media to use the new premium hero animation while preserving overlays and CTA behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section renders the new generated hero GIF from /assets/generated/ as the background media.
Overlay gradients remain in place and hero text remains readable on top of the animation.
No regressions to Hero CTAs (Get a Free Quote / Book Now / Call Us) and layout remains responsive.

file_operations.description: Replace the Hero background media source to use frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-electrician-distribution-board.dim_1600x900.gif while keeping the existing overlay gradient layers and all CTA behaviors unchanged; wrap background rendering with the new reduced-motion media helper (static fallback should use an existing still asset already in the repo, e.g., the current hero JPG).

requirements.summary: Add a new ultra-realistic looping Services panel-wiring close-up GIF asset.
acceptanceCriteria: A new generated GIF exists under frontend/public/assets/generated matching the described close-up panel wiring scene.
The animation loops seamlessly and contains no text/logos.

file_operations.description: Add the generated Services panel & wiring close-up looping GIF asset (hands tightening organized wiring in breaker panel; seamless loop; no text/logo).

requirements.summary: Integrate the new Services panel-wiring animation into the Services UI using existing styling patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: The Services section displays the new panel & wiring GIF from /assets/generated/.
The integration is responsive (mobile/desktop) and uses existing card/media styling patterns.
All existing Services CTAs continue to work.

file_operations.description: Update the Services media mapping to prominently display frontend/public/assets/generated/services-panel-wiring-closeup.dim_1200x800.gif for the most relevant service placement (e.g., Fuse/Panel Upgrades card) while preserving existing titles/descriptions/CTAs and existing responsive card layout; use the new reduced-motion media helper so prefers-reduced-motion users see a non-animated still (use an existing relevant JPG already in the repo as fallback).

requirements.summary: Add a new high-impact realistic looping emergency repair GIF asset with a softly glowing voltage tester.
acceptanceCriteria: A new generated GIF exists under frontend/public/assets/generated matching the emergency repair description.
The voltage tester glow is visible but not distracting; loop is seamless; no text/logos.

file_operations.description: Add the generated emergency repair looping GIF asset (electrician working inside power panel; softly glowing voltage tester; cinematic lighting; seamless loop; no text/logo).

requirements.summary: Integrate the new emergency repair animation into an existing on-page section consistent with current styling.
acceptanceCriteria: The new emergency repair GIF is rendered on the page from /assets/generated/.
Placement is consistent with existing section styling and remains responsive.
No layout overlap or CLS issues are introduced.

file_operations.description: Extend the existing electrician animations showcase section to include a new card that renders frontend/public/assets/generated/emergency-repair-voltage-tester.dim_1200x800.gif as a premium media tile (without introducing new routes); ensure the card follows existing Card spacing/styling patterns and uses the reduced-motion media helper to suppress animation for prefers-reduced-motion users (fallback to an existing still asset already in the repo).

requirements.summary: Add a new ultra-clean looping LED ceiling light installation GIF asset with a smooth light-on transition.
acceptanceCriteria: A new generated GIF exists under frontend/public/assets/generated matching the LED ceiling light installation description.
The light-on transition is smooth and loops seamlessly; no text/logos.

file_operations.description: Add the generated light installation looping GIF asset (electrician installing modern LED ceiling light; smooth light-on; voltage tester; seamless loop; no text/logo).

requirements.summary: Update the light-related service media to use the new light installation animation while keeping existing text/CTAs unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The Light Fitting/LED Work service card (or equivalent light-related placement) uses the new light installation GIF from /assets/generated/.
Existing service title/description and booking actions remain unchanged and functional.
Media loads with lazy-loading where already used in the Services section.

file_operations.description: Replace the Light Fitting/LED Work service card image with frontend/public/assets/generated/light-installation-led-ceiling.dim_1200x800.gif while preserving the existing service title/description/CTAs and keeping lazy-loading behavior; ensure prefers-reduced-motion uses the reduced-motion media helper with an existing still fallback already in the repo.

requirements.summary: Add a new cinematic looping trust/quality inspection GIF asset for brand-building.
acceptanceCriteria: A new generated GIF exists under frontend/public/assets/generated matching the trust/quality inspection scene.
The animation loops seamlessly and contains no text/logos.

file_operations.description: Add the generated trust/quality looping GIF asset (electrician inspecting organized panel; calm/confident; premium professional lighting; seamless loop; no text/logo).

requirements.summary: Integrate the trust/quality animation into a brand-building section while keeping all user-facing text in English and matching the existing visual system.
acceptanceCriteria: The trust/quality GIF is displayed on the page from /assets/generated/.
Any new user-facing text added for this integration is in English.
The section remains responsive and matches existing spacing/card styles.

file_operations.description: Integrate frontend/public/assets/generated/trust-quality-panel-inspection.dim_1200x800.gif into the existing About section as a brand-building media block (or media+text card) using existing Card styling and spacing; ensure any newly added headings/body text are in English; use the reduced-motion media helper with an existing still fallback already in the repo.

requirements.summary: Ensure all newly added animations respect prefers-reduced-motion with non-animated fallbacks, without editing immutable hook files.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled, the UI does not present motion-heavy animation for the newly integrated media (fallback behavior is applied).
No changes are made to any frontend immutablePaths files.

file_operations.description: Create a small reusable media component that uses the existing usePrefersReducedMotion hook to switch between an animated GIF source and a non-animated fallback source (existing still assets already present in frontend/public/assets/generated); ensure it can be used for hero/service/about/showcase media without requiring changes to any immutable hook files.
Adopt the new ReducedMotionMedia helper for the new hero background animation so prefers-reduced-motion users receive a non-animated fallback while preserving overlay gradients and layout.

Adopt the new ReducedMotionMedia helper for any cards updated to use the new premium GIFs (panel wiring and LED light installation) so prefers-reduced-motion users see non-animated fallbacks; preserve existing lazy-loading where applicable.
Use the new ReducedMotionMedia helper for the newly added emergency repair GIF tile so prefers-reduced-motion users do not see motion-heavy animation.
Use the new ReducedMotionMedia helper for the newly added trust/quality GIF integration so prefers-reduced-motion users see a non-animated fallback.
